name: Intelligent completions and inflow control devices
aliases: Intelligent completions and inflow control devices
principle: Downhole valves, gauges and inflow control devices let operators monitor and adjust production from each zone without intervention. In Kuwait's first smart multilateral well, two 10-position hydraulic valves and nozzle-type ICDs controlled two laterals to fight early water breakthrough.

process_steps.name: Valves choke or open each zone

performance.basis: two ICVs, one per lateral, Kuwait Minagish

source.note: JPT, Inflow-control device and inflow-control valves aid Kuwait's first smart multilateral well

limitations: The article gives production results only in a figure, not in text
